content: 第四关（前）

speaker: Ch'en
content: Move out.

raw: [name="L. G. D. Operator"]  But we're really not familiar with the layout here. I'm worried... what if the Infected resist our operations?
speaker: L. G. D. Operator
content: But we're really not familiar with the layout here. I'm worried... what if the Infected resist our operations?

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Relax. I know the area. Just follow my orders.
speaker: Ch'en
content: Relax. I know the area. Just follow my orders.

speaker: L. G. D. Operator
content: Yes, Sir!

raw: [name="L. G. D. Operator"]  Sir, bad news: intelligence reports Reunion is moving with some degree of organization again. It seems they've found another commander.
speaker: L. G. D. Operator
content: Sir, bad news: intelligence reports Reunion is moving with some degree of organization again. It seems they've found another commander.

raw: [name="L. G. D. Operator"]  And... and they've reencrypted their communication channels. We can't intercept them anymore!
speaker: L. G. D. Operator
content: And... and they've reencrypted their communication channels. We can't intercept them anymore!

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Could they have joined up with the units in the slums?
speaker: Ch'en
content: Could they have joined up with the units in the slums?

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Impossible. Rhodes Island should already have dealt with the situation there. There's no risk of us getting boxed in.
speaker: Ch'en
content: Impossible. Rhodes Island should already have dealt with the situation there. There's no risk of us getting boxed in.

speaker: Ch'en
content: Strange...

speaker: Swire
content: Ah Ch'en, I'm ready to——

speaker: Ch'en
content: A transmission?

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  'Little Miss,' would you mind giving me the room?
speaker: Ch'en
content: 'Little Miss,' would you mind giving me the room?

raw: [name="Swire"]  How do you work it out so you're busy every time I have something for you?
speaker: Swire
content: How do you work it out so you're busy every time I have something for you?

raw: [name="Swire"]  Is that spy of yours back on the grid?
speaker: Swire
content: Is that spy of yours back on the grid?

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  I said give me the room. And get me some finballs while you're out.
speaker: Ch'en
content: I said give me the room. And get me some finballs while you're out.

raw: [name="Swire"]  I'm not a kid, you know.
speaker: Swire
content: I'm not a kid, you know.

speaker: Ch'en
content: ...This is Ch'en.

raw: [name="???"]  We have another Reunion element up from the lower levels of the slums.
content: We have another Reunion element up from the lower levels of the slums.

raw: [name="???"]  Infected called Yeti Squad. It seems they have the ability to collapse buildings and destroy infrastructure.
content: Infected called Yeti Squad. It seems they have the ability to collapse buildings and destroy infrastructure.
Tread carefully.

speaker: Ch'en
content: ...Understood.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Only-1, Lungmen's special forces are operating in the slums. We are at the moment incapable of stopping them. Exercise caution.
speaker: Ch'en
content: Only-1, Lungmen's special forces are operating in the slums. We are at the moment incapable of stopping them. Exercise caution.
Roger.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  ...Only-1, why did you drop out of contact?
speaker: Ch'en
content: ...Only-1, why did you drop out of contact?

raw: [name="???"]  I had some things on my mind.
content: I had some things on my mind.

raw: [name="???"]  It's clear to me now. I'm leaving Lungmen to you.
content: It's clear to me now. I'm leaving Lungmen to you.

speaker: Ch'en
content: What? I don't understand.

raw: [name="???"]  Me, now? I don't belong here.
content: Me, now? I don't belong here.

speaker: Ch'en
content: Only-1!

raw: [name="???"]  I'm going to take some of Lungmen's Infected. The L. G. D. can't protect them. The city doesn't care about them.
content: I'm going to take some of Lungmen's Infected. The L. G. D. can't protect them. The city doesn't care about them.

raw: [name="???"]  In other words, this city isn't at all what you think it is.
content: In other words, this city isn't at all what you think it is.

speaker: Ch'en
content: Nine! You're under orders!

raw: [name="Nine"]  I haven't been with the L. G. D. for over three years.
speaker: Nine
content: I haven't been with the L. G. D. for over three years.

raw: [name="Nine"]  And actually it was me giving orders to you.
speaker: Nine
content: And actually it was me giving orders to you.

speaker: Ch'en
content: Nine...!

raw: [name="Nine"]  Those special forces you're talking about? I think I've seen them around.
speaker: Nine
content: Those special forces you're talking about? I think I've seen them around.

raw: [name="Nine"]  I thought too much of this city. Goodbye, Ch'en.
speaker: Nine
content: I thought too much of this city. Goodbye, Ch'en.

raw: [name="Nine"]  Oh, right. Don't go snooping around the sewers.
speaker: Nine
content: Oh, right. Don't go snooping around the sewers.

speaker: Ch'en
content: Was I too loud?

raw: [name="Swire"]  You're pretty loud. I think the whole block heard you.
speaker: Swire
content: You're pretty loud. I think the whole block heard you.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  And yet I'm still not as loud as you.
speaker: Ch'en
content: And yet I'm still not as loud as you.

raw: [name="Swire"]  Hey, Ah Ch'en, get over here.
speaker: Swire
content: Hey, Ah Ch'en, get over here.

speaker: Swire
content: Have a seat.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Wow, Miss Swire squatting on a dirty street corner. You're not afraid to soil your clothes?
speaker: Ch'en
content: Wow, Miss Swire squatting on a dirty street corner. You're not afraid to soil your clothes?

raw: [name="Swire"]  Certainly not! What makes you think I'd worry about a thing like that?
speaker: Swire
content: Certainly not! What makes you think I'd worry about a thing like that?

raw: [name="Swire"]  I was just about to give that stinky sewer rat another call.
speaker: Swire
content: I was just about to give that stinky sewer rat another call.

raw: [name="Swire"]  I may not come here often, but I'm pretty sure those special forces are up to no good.
speaker: Swire
content: I may not come here often, but I'm pretty sure those special forces are up to no good.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Have you met Lin? From the slums?
speaker: Ch'en
content: Have you met Lin? From the slums?

raw: [name="Swire"]  I have. He's a nice old man. Nicer than my grandpa anyway.
speaker: Swire
content: I have. He's a nice old man. Nicer than my grandpa anyway.

speaker: Ch'en
content: They call him the 'Rat King.'

raw: [name="Swire"]  The men behind the curtain aren't all like such. But he's really a good person.
speaker: Swire
content: The men behind the curtain aren't all like such. But he's really a good person.

raw: [name="Swire"]  I never thought Yühsia would turn out like this. She was such a shy and timid girl, the kind who would always hide behind you.
speaker: Swire
content: I never thought Yühsia would turn out like this. She was such a shy and timid girl, the kind who would always hide behind you.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  I don't think she's changed. She just... took on responsibility. Maybe the kind she couldn't handle.
speaker: Ch'en
content: I don't think she's changed. She just... took on responsibility. Maybe the kind she couldn't handle.

raw: [name="Swire"]  It wouldn't do any good to tell her that. We're between a rock and hard place here.
speaker: Swire
content: It wouldn't do any good to tell her that. We're between a rock and hard place here.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  I can't say I understand what's going on between her and her father, but I know she's not so cold-blooded.
speaker: Ch'en
content: I can't say I understand what's going on between her and her father, but I know she's not so cold-blooded.

speaker: Swire
content: So I'm gonna call her.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  That report I just got may be of use to us.
speaker: Ch'en
content: That report I just got may be of use to us.

speaker: Swire
content: What do you mean?

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  A Reunion group with special powers has entered the slums, and they're able to command other Reunion elements.
speaker: Ch'en
content: A Reunion group with special powers has entered the slums, and they're able to command other Reunion elements.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  And I'm the only one who knows. Well, now it's the two of us, I guess.
speaker: Ch'en
content: And I'm the only one who knows. Well, now it's the two of us, I guess.

speaker: Swire
content: What are you thinking?

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  We steer the raincoats into them.
speaker: Ch'en
content: We steer the raincoats into them.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Aside from the group left to help the L. G. D. clean up the new-type Infected, there's also quite a few of those special forces with us in the slums.
speaker: Ch'en
content: Aside from the group left to help the L. G. D. clean up the new-type Infected, there's also quite a few of those special forces with us in the slums.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  And the situation is: we don't know their distribution, we have no way to guard against them, and have no idea what they might do.
speaker: Ch'en
content: And the situation is: we don't know their distribution, we have no way to guard against them, and have no idea what they might do.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  But with Lin Yühsia's help, we can guide them into that Reunion team.
speaker: Ch'en
content: But with Lin Yühsia's help, we can guide them into that Reunion team.

raw: [name="Swire"]  Force them out? Show them to the whole L. G. D.?
speaker: Swire
content: Force them out? Show them to the whole L. G. D.?

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  The L. G. D., sure, but also Rhodes Island.
speaker: Ch'en
content: The L. G. D., sure, but also Rhodes Island.

speaker: Swire
content: You trust them so much?

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  They chase their objectives harder than any group I've ever seen. They're even more dedicated than the L. G. D.
speaker: Ch'en
content: They chase their objectives harder than any group I've ever seen. They're even more dedicated than the L. G. D.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  And who else are we going to trust?
speaker: Ch'en
content: And who else are we going to trust?

raw: [name="Swire"]  You've got stones, I'll give you that.
speaker: Swire
content: You've got stones, I'll give you that.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Ordinary Lungmenites don't know Lin, they don't know your grandfather, they don't even really know Wei Yenwu, let alone any chambers of commerce or whatever behind the scenes.
speaker: Ch'en
content: Ordinary Lungmenites don't know Lin, they don't know your grandfather, they don't even really know Wei Yenwu, let alone any chambers of commerce or whatever behind the scenes.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  They just trust the L. G. D. None of those players would dare disband the L. G. D., and leave us with the regular old police.
speaker: Ch'en
content: They just trust the L. G. D. None of those players would dare disband the L. G. D., and leave us with the regular old police.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Then you add in the outsiders... And there's no way they'll want to take over.
speaker: Ch'en
content: Then you add in the outsiders... And there's no way they'll want to take over.

speaker: Swire
content: They'll fire you though.

speaker: Ch'en
content: Whoop-de-doo.

raw: [name="Swire"]  Then let's wrap up this one last job! Next time, their patrol route goes right into the slums.
speaker: Swire
content: Then let's wrap up this one last job! Next time, their patrol route goes right into the slums.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  You can get Lin on board?
speaker: Ch'en
content: You can get Lin on board?

raw: [name="Swire"]  As long as we look after this place, Lin will work with us.
speaker: Swire
content: As long as we look after this place, Lin will work with us.

speaker: Ch'en
content: One more thing...

speaker: Swire
content: What's that?

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Did you know we have three guests?
speaker: Ch'en
content: Did you know we have three guests?

speaker: Lin Yühsia
content: What is it?

raw: [name="Swire"]  Listen up, stinky rat, I've got news for you. There's a Reunion unit we can't hold. We need your team's help.
speaker: Swire
content: Listen up, stinky rat, I've got news for you. There's a Reunion unit we can't hold. We need your team's help.

raw: [name="Lin Yühsia"]  Impossible. What are you trying to pull?
speaker: Lin Yühsia
content: Impossible. What are you trying to pull?

raw: [name="Swire"]  Have I ever lied to you?
speaker: Swire
content: Have I ever lied to you?

raw: [name="Lin Yühsia"]  You said we'd go to the same secondary school, only for you to run off to Victoria.
speaker: Lin Yühsia
content: You said we'd go to the same secondary school, only for you to run off to Victoria.

speaker: Swire
content: I'm sorry. Really, truly sorry.

raw: [name="Lin Yühsia"]  Forget it. I don't care.
speaker: Lin Yühsia
content: Forget it. I don't care.

raw: [name="Swire"]  Yühsia, your dad has done so much for Lungmen. We don't want to lose this place, and the people here can't lose us either.
speaker: Swire
content: Yühsia, your dad has done so much for Lungmen. We don't want to lose this place, and the people here can't lose us either.

speaker: Lin Yühsia
content: Liar. You're coming here?

raw: [name="Lin Yühsia"]  You'll come to the slums?
speaker: Lin Yühsia
content: You'll come to the slums?

speaker: Swire
content: ......Ch'en will.

raw: [name="Lin Yühsia"]  You really are a terrible liar. What business have I with her?
speaker: Lin Yühsia
content: You really are a terrible liar. What business have I with her?

raw: [name="Swire"]  For whatever reason, your dad wasn't able to resolve the conflict between the Infected and the normal people, but Ch'en can.
speaker: Swire
content: For whatever reason, your dad wasn't able to resolve the conflict between the Infected and the normal people, but Ch'en can.

raw: [name="Swire"]  Ch'en and your father will rebuild the slums together.
speaker: Swire
content: Ch'en and your father will rebuild the slums together.

raw: [name="Swire"]  They're working to turn it into a place where all kinds of people can live, to the point that we won't even be able to call it the slums anymore.
speaker: Swire
content: They're working to turn it into a place where all kinds of people can live, to the point that we won't even be able to call it the slums anymore.

raw: [name="Swire"]  Think about it... Even though most Lungmenites don't live here, they've been coming here a lot in the past few years, haven't they?
speaker: Swire
content: Think about it... Even though most Lungmenites don't live here, they've been coming here a lot in the past few years, haven't they?

raw: [name="Swire"]  Soon, we won't need any slums.
speaker: Swire
content: Soon, we won't need any slums.

speaker: Lin Yühsia
content: What?

raw: [name="Swire"]  We haven't been able to solve the Infected crisis, but I know... We can make this a better place.
speaker: Swire
content: We haven't been able to solve the Infected crisis, but I know... We can make this a better place.

raw: [name="Swire"]  They'll be Lungmen's downtown Districts 22 to 29. No longer 'slums.'
speaker: Swire
content: They'll be Lungmen's downtown Districts 22 to 29. No longer 'slums.'

raw: [name="Swire"]  This city was built on the many, many different kinds of people all coming together to make it what it is today.
speaker: Swire
content: This city was built on the many, many different kinds of people all coming together to make it what it is today.

raw: [name="Swire"]  Lungmen can't afford to lose anyone.
speaker: Swire
content: Lungmen can't afford to lose anyone.

raw: [name="Lin Yühsia"]  Yawn. How boring. You've become as boring as Ch'en.
speaker: Lin Yühsia
content: Yawn. How boring. You've become as boring as Ch'en.

speaker: Swire
content: Yühsia...

raw: [name="Swire"]  Look, I'm not trying to make a soap opera here.
speaker: Swire
content: Look, I'm not trying to make a soap opera here.

raw: [name="Lin Yühsia"]  Where is that Reunion unit?
speaker: Lin Yühsia
content: Where is that Reunion unit?

speaker: Swire
content: Oh?

speaker: Lin Yühsia
content: I won't ask again.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Amiya, have you entered the slums?
speaker: Ch'en
content: Amiya, have you entered the slums?

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  We have a bit of a situation here. Let me fill you in.
speaker: Ch'en
content: We have a bit of a situation here. Let me fill you in.
